## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

Who would benefit from this feature? Provide specific use cases.

## Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas on how to implement this, share them here:
- Which components would be affected?
- Any specific APIs or interfaces?
- Dependencies or prerequisites?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for duplicates
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals
- [ ] I have considered the maintenance burden
